title: The Biggest Rodent on Earth Can Hide Underwater for 5 Minutes

scenes.text: The biggest rodent on Earth can vanish underwater for five minutes.
A capybara can weigh up to 174 pounds. It's the largest rodent in the world.
When danger comes, it runs for the water. Its feet are slightly webbed.
It can stay submerged for up to five minutes.
Its eyes, ears and nostrils sit high on its head, so they can peek above the surface.
An adult's main enemy is the jaguar. Young ones also face caimans, anacondas and harpy eagles.

description:
The biggest rodent on Earth can vanish underwater for five minutes.
A capybara can weigh up to 174 pounds and uses water to hide from predators like jaguars.
Would you hide underwater too? Tell us below.
